# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation delivery modernization**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.154 release improves how SkiaSharp API documentation is generated, packaged, and delivered to consumers. Compiler XML documentation now travels with packages, while generated binding structure and HarfBuzz source synchronization improve maintainability.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **API documentation ships with packages** — Compiler-generated XML documentation accompanies managed assemblies so IDE consumers receive current API descriptions directly from the package. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Generated binding sources are organized by type** — Interop declarations are split into per-type generated files, and HarfBuzz bindings are generated from the native source pinned by Skia. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
